title: Comparison harness vs aff3ct and IT++
description:
## Goal

Side-by-side comparison harness producing AWGN BLER curves for
DVB-T2 r1/2 16-QAM and at least one 5G NR LDPC configuration vs
aff3ct or IT++ on the same channel parameters.

## Context

Task under story `a5635da5` (5G NR LDPC real-time and research
enablers) within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Placeholder body —
project-lead expands during claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] Comparison curves committed under
  `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/comparison/` for at least one DVB-T2
  configuration and one 5G NR LDPC configuration vs at least one
  of aff3ct or IT++.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals.
